text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City was participating in a fan meetup
organized by Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you very much!
Please keep showing off how cute—I mean, how cool you are!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
!? Wh-Whaaat...!?
'Cute', you say...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what's the deal with this?
Don't the fans look down on us a bit too much...?
choice_data_list: I don't think that's true, though.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, my sheer intensity isn't coming through at all!
Dammit, why...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Did I go overboard with the autographs
and handshakes? ...In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I ain't cuttin' 'em no slack anymore, no way in hell!
That'll teach 'em to fear me!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! E-Espo-san!
U-Um... well...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Yeah, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If you've got something to say, spit it out already.
...*Hmph*."

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... p-please take this!
W-Well, see ya...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? What's this?
A letter...?"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text: "『Nice to meet you, Espo-san. I'm sure I'd get too nervous if I met you in person... so please allow me to put my feelings into this letter.』"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
""I've never had much confidence in myself since I was little...
I used to give up on so many things, thinking, 'Someone like me could never do it anyway.'""

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"But, watching you run, Espo-san...
made me want to change who I am."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text: "Because Espo-san—saying 'Watch me, everyone' and 'I'm the strongest' as she took on the race without backing down an inch—looked so incredibly radiant to me."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's step by step, I want to become strong just like you.
You gave me that courage—so I'll keep cheering for you forever!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ……What is it?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you, the one who just gave me that letter!
Wait up a second!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You came all the way out here to see me, didn't you!
You really think just handing over a letter is enough, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh... WHAAAAT!?
Is it really okay for me to make a wish...!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! What the hell are you saying?!
It's not even a big deal!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Just tell me what you want already! An autograph?! A handshake?! Come on, out with it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, hey!
Trainer, what are you smirking at!
Don't you go underestimating me!"
